_comment: Localized App Store screenshot captions for Kanji Extractor, one entry per scene. 'title' is the headline, 'sub' a short subline; the privacy scene uses 'bullets' instead of 'sub'. 'accent' is the scene's glow colour (RGB). Wording follows src/_locales. Nothing here may promise a feature the Safari app does not ship (iCloud sync is Safari-only and appears only in scene 4).
